title: 20 Lessons Selling $20M of Online Writing Courses
description:
✍️ Want to start writing online? Download this free Ultimate Guide to get started: https://yt.startwritingonline.com

🤖 Want to write online, start (or scale) a newsletter, and launch digital products? Come join me LIVE inside our AI Writing Skool: https://www.skool.com/ai-writing-skool

––– My Books –––

📗 The Art & Business of Online Writing: https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B0FWK4BQB9

📙 The Art & Business of Ghostwriting: https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B0FW4PWRSH

📘 Writer Career Paths: https://www.amazon.com/Writer-Career-Paths-Ways-Words-ebook/dp/B0GPR1G9NB

––– Socials –––

Twitter/X: https://x.com/Nicolascole77

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nicolascole77

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@nicolascole77

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/nicolascole/

Medium: https://nicolascole77.medium.com/

––– About –––

If you’re new to my channel… hey there! 

My name is Nicolas Cole and I’ve been writing online since 2007. 

Since then, I’ve generated over a billion views on my writing, written 10+ books, and built multiple 7+ figure writing-related businesses, including two of the largest writing programs on the Internet: Ship 30 for 30 & Premium Ghostwriting Academy. 

I have made millions of dollars writing online, so I fundamentally reject this narrative (pun intended) “nobody makes a living as a writer.”

Yes, you absolutely can make a living as a writer. In fact, you can make more than just a living. You can make tons of money as a writer… IF… you’re a digital writer, and embrace learning the new skills required to thrive in a digital world. 

Which is why I started this YouTube channel.

Consider me your Digital Writing Mentor!

On this channel I talk about:

- Digital Writing
- Fiction Writing
- Ghostwriting
- Writing With AI
- Self-Publishing
- Writing Services & Business Models

So if you have any questions, drop me a comment on any video and I’ll answer them in a future video!

Keep writing,

Cole

#digitalwriting #entrepreneurship #onlinebusiness 

0:00 → Introduction
1:26 → Lesson #1: Subjectivity doesn't scale.
3:10 → Lesson #2: If traffic is concentrated, scale vertically. If decentralized, scale horizontally.
5:11 → Lesson #3: It takes about 20 live webinars to figure out how to make a webinar ROI positive.
7:03 → Lesson #4: The more money you make, the more likely you are to spend it on the wrong things.
8:41 → Lesson #5: Limit salespeople's commissions to their current employment.
11:07 → Lesson #6: You can do "more" way longer than you think.
13:10 → Lesson #7: When you reach a "better" plateau, the impulse is to pick something "new" (which is a mistake).
16:09 → Lesson #8: There is no one-right-way to drive traffic to a business.
17:27 → Lesson #9: If you don't see traction with the budget version, don't spend money on the premium version.
20:25 → Lesson #10: You can't automate what you can't articulate.
22:04 → Lesson #11: When you find a marketing tactic that works, do as much of it as you can.
24:50 → Lesson #12: The best managers are entrepreneurs and should be incentivized accordingly.
27:42 → Lesson #13: Whatever gets your attention, grows. Everything else atrophies.
30:07 → Lesson #14: Customers don't want more information. They want better results, faster, with less work.
32:01 → Lesson #15: Don't anchor your business's profit (or personal income) to your highest-performing month.
33:22 → Lesson #16: If you truly want to scale your business, you have to be motivated by more than just money.
35:33 → Lesson #17: Info + Software + Coaching = Compounding Profit.
37:45 → Lesson #18: Your team members watch what you do more than they listen to what you say.
39:47 → Lesson #19: As soon as you know what to do, stop consuming content.
41:30 → Lesson #20: Every time you change what you "want", you disrupt compounding and start over.
